bottleneck_attribution_analysis._answer: This experiment does NOT decide it. Both readings are consistent with the data below.
bottleneck_attribution_analysis._question: Is the bottleneck the generator (models too inaccurate) or the gate (threshold too strict)?
bottleneck_attribution_analysis.reading_A_generator_too_weak: 14 of 29 scored rounds predicted held-out transitions at accuracy exactly 0.0 -- the induced world model was wholly wrong, not marginally short. A further 5 landed strictly between 0 and 1 ([0.125, 0.5, 0.5, 0.875, 0.875]). A gate that rejects a model mispredicting 100% of held-out transitions is the gate working correctly.
bottleneck_attribution_analysis.reading_B_gate_too_strict: heldout_threshold is exactly 1.0, so a single wrong transition rejects the model. 10 of 29 rounds nonetheless cleared it (6 at the full n=25), which is evidence the threshold is not unreachable. Relaxing it to 0.875 would admit models wrong on 1 transition in 8, whose plans would then execute against a mispredicting model.
bottleneck_attribution_analysis.superseded_claim: An earlier draft asserted the dynamics gate was 'never cleared (best 0.875)'. That was false and self-contradicted; it is corrected above and preserved in the corrigendum block.
bottleneck_attribution_analysis.what_the_data_DOES_localize: Of the 10 rounds that cleared the dynamics gate, 8 were then killed by the GOAL gate and only 2 produced a plan. The goal gate is where the surviving models die, and both of the end-to-end passes occurred at transition_count=1, where accuracy 1.0 is close to trivially attainable.

superseded_fields.headline: Removing the LLM induction tier entirely leaves the live agent's action stream BYTE-IDENTICAL on 5 of 6 games, and changes exactly ONE action out of 60 on the sixth (vc33, at trace index 59 -- the final decision of the episode). Both A/A noise floors are byte-identical on all 6 cells (12/12 replicate pairs, zero divergence), so the harness is deterministic and the one-action difference IS attributable to the LLM -- it is simply almost the entire effect. The tier FIRED in 6 of 6 cells (real CUDA gemma-4-31B induction, 345-1673s each) but its output reached the policy in only 1 of 6: the other 5 inductions were produced and then discarded by the downstream trust gate. This is a reachability failure at the GATE, not at the generator.
superseded_fields.internal_control_worth_noting: On tn36 the two ON replicates produced DIFFERENT induction outcomes (degenerate_goal_predicate vs world_model_accuracy_below_threshold) and still emitted byte-identical 60-action traces. The LLM's output changed and the agent's behaviour did not -- independent corroboration that the tier is decoupled from the action stream, obtained without needing the OFF arm at all.
limitations: 6 games, 1 seed each, 60-action budget, max_inductions=2. This is an ACTIVATION pre-flight, not a powered endpoint test; the shipped instrument REFUSES the sign test (ceiling 1 discordant pair vs 6 required at alpha=0.05) and that refusal is the correct reading, not a null result about the LLM's value.

vc33's single divergence lands at index 59 of a 60-action budget, so the effect is CENSORED: the one plan the tier ever got past the gate was 1 action long and began executing on the final step. A larger action budget is required before anyone can say whether that plan would have compounded. This is the single most important caveat and it points AT the treatment, not away from it.

sc25's ON arm induce FAILED outright (proposer_failed_or_missing_root after ~1450s), so that cell's IDENTICAL is partly a generator failure rather than a gate rejection. Counted honestly in the funnel above rather than folded into the gate-rejection count.

The OFF arm removes the generator; it does not remove the induction PHASE. The agent still stalls, still calls induce, and still gets a (False, reason) answer. That is the correct operationalization of 'delete the LLM, keep everything else', but it is not the same as an agent designed without an induction phase.

what_this_does_and_does_not_license.NOT_licensed: This does NOT show the LLM tier CANNOT help. It shows the tier's output is being discarded by the world-model trust gate before it can act, in 5 of 6 cells. The actionable target is the GATE (accuracy threshold, goal-predicate satisfiability) and the action budget, not the generator or the inducer model. A better inducer banking zero extra levels is exactly what this topology predicts.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.licensed: Every A/B this session that moved a COMPONENT of the induce -> verify -> plan apparatus was, on 5 of 6 games, measuring a component whose output never reaches the policy. duration_s_note: Sum of the two lanes' wall clock plus the two smoke cells. The ON arm cost 345-1673s per cell against 5-43s for the OFF arm -- a 40-190x wall-clock multiplier for the measured effect above.

actions_to_first_solve.note: Defined in 1 of 6 games: the other five solve nothing in EITHER arm at a 60-action budget, so the endpoint is undefined there independently of the LLM. At support n=1 an exact two-sided sign test cannot reach alpha=0.05 (6 one-way discordant pairs required, 2*0.5^6=0.031), so a MAXIMAL effect could not have been significant. This endpoint is unfalsifiable at this support.

banked_levels.note: 3 of 3 banked levels are vc33's, identical on both arms. Baseline 3/3 unchanged.

endpoint_phase2.sign_test_note: Exact two-sided sign test needs 6 one-way discordant pairs for p<0.05. At k<=5 the minimum reachable p is >=0.0625. Every endpoint here has k=0 discordant pairs and at most 1 cell capable of discordance.

the_plan_that_passed.note: The one plan that ever cleared both gates was 1 action long and began executing on the final step of the budget, after all progress was banked. Whether it would compound is UNMEASURED. This caveat points AT the treatment, not away from it.

vc33_the_only_attributable_cell.why_total_actions_is_NOT_an_efficiency_g: RESET is not counted as an env action. The ON arm's lower total_actions (58 vs 59) is RESET bookkeeping: it issues two RESETs (index 0 and 59) to the OFF arm's one. Nothing was solved faster -- both level-ups occurred at identical action indices inside the byte-identical 0..58 prefix.

inference_substrate.principle: The ON arm loads and runs a real 31B GGUF; the OFF arm loads no model at all. Declaring the substrate is what lets the duration floor distinguish a real live run from a fabricated one -- and under THIS experiment's hypothesis an accidental LLM-off ON arm would fabricate exactly the result being sought.

n_ab_perturbed.principle: A byte-identical A/B pair is a NON-OBSERVATION, not a tie: the two arms are the same agent on that cell and no downstream endpoint can differ. Counting perturbation separately from attribution keeps a nondeterministic harness from reading as a treatment effect.

n_attributable.principle: A cell counts only when BOTH arms were separately witnessed to repeat themselves there. One A/A floor measures one arm's determinism; an A/B spans two, and crediting the control arm's self-perturbation to the treatment is the exact over-claim the second floor prevents.

n_cells_llm_tier_fired.principle: Reachability is reported SEPARATELY from value. A cell where the tier never fired is evidence about the tier's REACHABILITY, not about its worth; conflating the two is how an earlier measurement returned UNFALSIFIABLE.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: Declared on every artifact that could be read as a verifier claim so a circular win can never headline as a moat.

harness_caveats.build_check_enforcement_gap: server_exe_is_cuda_build (derived from /proc/<pid>/exe) was RECORDED but never ENFORCED -- there was no refusal branch on False. The enforced check read prop._proc.args[0], which equals the literal string 'reused_existing' on 10 of the 12 ON cells, so the documented 'HARD BLOCKS on a build-hip binary' did not actually fire for reused servers. No cell was at risk in practice: all 12 ON cells recorded server_exe_is_cuda_build=true and the independent per-PID VRAM residency gate (21.4GB on the requested bus) would have refused an iGPU bind. Fixed in the harness after the fact: the refusal now derives from /proc/<pid>/exe, which is available for reused and freshly-spawned servers alike, and an unreadable exe is treated as UNVERIFIED (refuse) rather than as a pass.
harness_caveats.gpu_allocation: lp85 and sc25 ran on GPU 0, which per the 2026-06-27 operator allocation is the CONDUCTOR's dedicated card (the outer loop owns GPU 1). This is not a validity flaw -- the harness fixes one GPU per game, so the card axis is constant inside every quadruple and cannot be confounded with the arm axis -- but it is a contention risk and is the plausible cause of those two cells being the slowest in the grid. Future probe cells should be pinned to GPU 1.
harness_caveats.max_inductions_was_nominal: max_inductions=2 was requested as the GENEROUS setting for the treatment, but only 1 induction actually fired on 5 of 6 games (hit_induction_cap=false everywhere): just one stall arose inside the 60-action budget. Only vc33 reached 2. The previous grid's structural blindness was therefore fixed by REMOVING THE EARLY LOOP BREAK after the induction -- leaving a post-induction window in which the tier could have moved the trace -- and not by granting a second induction on most games.
harness_caveats.verification_provenance: scripts/test_suite_mutation_check.py --check REFUSES with 'no baseline for this run' when no run id is pinned, and still exits 0 -- so a bare invocation is not evidence of anything. Under CARNOT_MUTATION_RUN_ID=ph3_review_20260730 it returns 'OK -- no tracked file was modified since the snapshot'. The working tree carried 3 files dirty BEFORE this measurement began (2 under docs/research-notes/ and ops/.arc_leaderboard_technique_watch_state.json); that exact porcelain string is recorded verbatim in all 24 cells' arm_git_status_porcelain field.

wall_clock_margin.truncation_direction_argument: No cell truncated (all 24 have timed_out=false and a full 60-action trace). This matters directionally: only the ON arm is slow enough to be truncated (OFF 5-43s vs ON 345-1673s), so a truncation would censor the TREATMENT arm only, and zero-filling it would bias toward exactly the tie this experiment tests for. A truncation is a MISSING OBSERVATION, never a zero. The tightest cell finished 26.6s (1.56%) inside the cap, so a rerun at that cap is one slow load away from censoring the treatment. The harness default has since been raised to 2400s.

preflight_verdict.interpretation: PASS means only that the treatment perturbs enough cells for the planned sign test to be ABLE to reach significance. It does NOT mean the experiment is powered: perturbation is necessary but not sufficient for discordance on the endpoint. REFUSE means no possible outcome of the grid reaches alpha, so running it cannot produce a finding. INCONCLUSIVE means the probe itself is not finished -- cells are still outstanding that could carry it to a PASS -- so it is NOT evidence that the treatment is inert and must never be cited as one.

two_level_verdict._why_stated_separately: An earlier draft applied the level-2 caveat to the level-1 question ('I will not claim a tie'), which reads as hedging a finding the operator explicitly asked not to soften. The system-level question has a clean answer; only the counterfactual-generator question does not.

level_1_system_as_deployed.hedge: None. This level is not qualified by level 2.
level_1_system_as_deployed.statement: Deleting the LLM induction tier changes nothing measurable. 0 action changes on 5 of 6 games; 1 action of 60 on the sixth, and that action is a terminal RESET that scores nothing. Banked levels identical (3 of 3 total, all on vc33, both arms). actions-to-first-solve identical wherever it is defined. The induce -> verify -> plan apparatus, as currently configured, contributes no measurable score. 0.08 on the leaderboard is consistent with what exploration alone produces.

level_2_generator_capability.statement: Whether a BETTER inducer could help is not answered here, because the gate blocks the output before it acts. This is a real caveat about the treatment's ceiling -- it is NOT a reason to soften level 1.

verifier_is_oracle_note: No verifier claim is made. This measures whether REMOVING the LLM induction tier changes the live agent's ACTION STREAM. No moat, efficiency or value-added claim.

what_this_does_and_does_not_license.NOT_licensed: This does NOT show the LLM tier CANNOT help, and it does NOT localize the failure to the gate rather than the generator. The models were rejected for being inaccurate (14 of 29 scored rounds at heldout accuracy exactly 0.0), which is equally consistent with 'the generator is too weak' and 'the gate is too strict'. The actionable target is the gate/generator PAIR plus the action budget; naming either one alone is beyond what this measurement supports.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.licensed: Every A/B this session that moved a COMPONENT of the induce -> verify -> plan apparatus was, on 5 of 6 games, measuring a component whose output never reaches the policy. Those nulls are explained without needing any claim about the component. The 0.08 leaderboard plateau is consistent with exploration alone producing the score. At the system level, deleting the tier is a TIE.
what_this_does_and_does_not_license.priority_implied: Make induction FIRE end-to-end -- i.e. produce models the gate can accept and goals it can satisfy -- before spending anything further on making the inducer BETTER. A 6x better inducer banking zero extra levels is exactly what this topology predicts.
